svg.title: Super Gamedev Agent
svg.desc: A pixel-art game level: a hero jumps from Idea to Brief, Build, Verify, Art and sound, Playtest and Ship, watched by a team of AI roles (designer, programmer, artist, QA, producer). Paths for first games, hobby ideas, your engine and studios.
